At his roughly 0.70 catch rate, about 3.8 targets still implies receptions near or slightly above 2.5. Defense and venue adjustments are small. The main weakness is that thin target volume, such as his one-target Week 2, can sink the bet.","price_case":"This is FanDuel's central 2.5 line with no alternates, so it is not an alternate-line artifact. The bet needs to win about two times in five to break even. Other books price the over at +125 to +130, so FanDuel is the outlier. Calibration trims the raw model estimate substantially, and the market blend trims it further toward break-even, leaving only a thin margin.","context_case":"Pittsburgh is missing two defensive backs, which could ease Jeudy's coverage. The model's season-level defense rating may not reflect these absences.","kind":"injury","direction":"supports","represented_in":"unknown"}]}]}
